record_title: Anisotropy controls Moore–Penrose triple transfer in adjoint matrix rings
provenance: Exact anisotropy criterion for two Moore–Penrose transposed-triple conditions in adjoint endomorphism rings, with an isotropic rank-one obstruction and finite-field transpose classification.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The result does not settle the source question for arbitrary *-rings. The full texts of Pearl (1968) and Huylebrouck-Puystjens-Van Geel (1988) were not independently inspected and remain residual prior-art risks. No independent validation is asserted.
